other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Kerala state

Must possess a first‑class Master’s degree in Life Sciences (including Veterinary Science, Agriculture, Forestry, Fisheries) or a Master’s in Medicine followed by a PhD in a biotechnologically relevant field
Candidate must have submitted their PhD thesis and have quality publications in indexed (SCI) journals
Must not be receiving any fellowship or grant from any other source
Cannot have previously availed a post‑doctoral fellowship from KSCSTE or any other agency
Age limit is below 35 years, with an additional relaxation of up to 5 years for SC, ST, women and physically handicapped candidates
Post‑doctoral fellow must join a suitable institution other than the parent institution unless justified
benefits_summary: Monthly stipend of ₹32,000 plus 10% HRA and an annual contingent grant of ₹50,000 (₹22,000 plus 10% HRA for candidates awaiting PhD award).
